title: Customer Equity Management
description:
Prerequisite: BUSI650; or BUSM612; or BUSO612.
Restriction: Must be in Business and Management (Master's) program; or permission of BMGT-Robert H. Smith School of Business.
Credit only granted for: BUMK722, BUMK750 or BUSO740. This course focuses on managing customers of a business, whether in B2B or B2C space, as a portfolio of equity. It provides an understanding of the current and future value of customers to the business. Topics include selective acquisition, development, and retention of customers using latest developments in information technology.
